items.followUp: Define biotechnology and state one way it can benefit the economy.

rubric.why: Identifies bioeconomics as a field of biology.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying bioeconomics as a branch or field of biology.

rubric.why: States what bioeconomics studies: the economic importance or value of organisms or biological resources.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for linking organisms or biological resources with their economic importance or value.

modelAnswer: Bioeconomics is the branch of biology that deals with the economic importance of organisms.

items.followUp: Compare xylem vessel elements with xylem tracheids.

rubric.why: Identifies sieve tube cells by their role in transporting food through the phloem.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that sieve tube cells transport food; their arrangement end to end and perforated sieve plates are also distinguishing features.

rubric.why: Identifies companion cells by their nucleus or their supporting role alongside sieve tubes.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that companion cells have a nucleus or support sieve tubes in food transport.

modelAnswer: Sieve tube cells are joined end to end by perforated sieve plates and transport food through the phloem.
Companion cells are nucleated cells beside sieve tubes that support them and help maintain food transport.
